cases.title: Event detected near the end of the trip is PARTIAL with an explicit reason
cases.input: S05 at 135 s -> detection ~136 s; trip ends at 155 s
cases.expected: status PARTIAL and a limitation text; last sample = trip end
cases.actual: [["MS_SUPPLY", "PARTIAL", 155000, ["توقف المصدر قبل اكتمال 30 ثانية بعد الحدث"]]]

cases.title: Event at trip start keeps the available pre-window and states it is shorter
cases.expected: first sample = 0 and a limitation 'shorter than 30 s'
cases.actual: first=0 limitations=['نافذة ما قبل الحدث أقصر من 30 ثانية؛ حُفظت البيانات المتاحة فقط']

cases.title: A fault that disappears after 5 s does not cancel the event (recording continues to T+30)
cases.input: S05 and S06 for 5 s each
cases.expected: event exists and last sample >= detection + 29 s

cases.title: Overlapping events: each keeps its own full window; shared samples stored once
cases.expected: >=2 distinct non-quality events, windows overlap, samples shared via event_samples (not duplicated in measurements)
cases.actual: kinds=['MS_AIR_FUEL', 'MS_THERMAL']; overlapping=True; shared sample rows=204

cases.title: Manual stop during recording finalizes the event as PARTIAL with the reason
cases.input: stop at 80 s, detection at 68.2 s
cases.expected: PARTIAL, last sample ~80 s, reason recorded
cases.actual: [('MS_THERMAL', 'PARTIAL', 80000, ['توقف المصدر قبل اكتمال 30 ثانية بعد الحدث'])]

cases.title: Abrupt close during recording: the event is recovered as PARTIAL on reopen with its checkpoint samples
cases.input: abandon the session without stop() at 80 s, reopen the database
cases.expected: status RECORDING before reopen; PARTIAL after with samples up to the last checkpoint; session marked interrupted
cases.actual: before=['RECORDING'] after=PARTIAL samples=210 last=80000 limitations=['استُعيد تسجيل غير مكتمل بعد توقف سابق؛ البيانات بعد الحدث جزئية'] sessions=[<sqlite3.Row object at 0x00000201049A4610>]

cases.title: Irregular arrival rate (100-400 ms): windows follow sample time, not row count
cases.expected: no sample outside the time window; ordered; coverage by time
cases.actual: MS_THERMAL@90.1s n=232 first=60.4 last=119.9 COMPLETE

cases.title: 20% missing samples: window bounds hold and missing intervals are measurable, not invented
cases.expected: no sample outside [T-30,T+30]; no synthetic samples (count <= nominal)
cases.actual: DATA_QUALITY@187.1s n=114 gaps=39 PARTIAL; DATA_QUALITY@156.7s n=184 gaps=72 COMPLETE; DATA_QUALITY@126.4s n=186 gaps=71 COMPLETE; DATA_QUALITY@95.4s n=197 gaps=71 COMPLETE

cases.title: New database: documented tables, user_version=2, foreign keys ON, WAL, synchronous FULL

cases.actual: tables=['analyses', 'detection_evidence', 'diagnostic_reports', 'event_ai_status', 'event_analyses', 'event_samples', 'events', 'extension_migrations', 'measurements', 'sessions', 'simulation_runs'] user_version=2 foreign_keys=1 journal=wal synchronous=2

cases.title: Stored run: integrity ok, no FK violations, measurements and event samples consistent

cases.expected: integrity_check ok; foreign_key_check empty; 776 measurements; no cross-session event samples
cases.actual: integrity=ok fk_violations=0 measurements=776 cross_session=0

cases.title: Stored reports exist for every finished event and equal a fresh rebuild from the stored event
cases.expected: every finished event has a report; stored == rebuilt
cases.actual: reports=1 finished_events=1 equal=[True]

cases.title: Re-saving the same event does not duplicate; conflicting overwrite of a finalized event is refused
cases.input: save_event twice; save altered finalized event
cases.expected: count unchanged; conflict raises
cases.actual: count 1->1; conflict=ValueError: Final event end must match the last sample and follow detection

cases.title: A measurement whose session was never saved is not stored as an orphan
cases.expected: rejected (FK) and no row
cases.actual: result=IntegrityError rows=0

cases.title: Reopening returns identical events
cases.expected: identical lists
cases.actual: 1 events identical=True

cases.title: Older (v1) database is upgraded in place; a future schema is refused
cases.input: synthetic v1 db; synthetic user_version=99 db
cases.expected: v1 -> all v2 tables present; 99 -> error
cases.actual: migrated: user_version=2; future: refused: ValueError: Unsupported database version 99

cases.title: Write failure raises and stores nothing; corrupt, missing-folder and directory paths raise clear errors
cases.input: query_only write; garbage file; missing directory; directory as path
cases.expected: all raise; no partial row
cases.actual: write=OperationalError: attempt to write a readonly database; corrupt=DatabaseError: file is not a database; directory=OperationalError: unable to open database file; missing folders: OPENED (the repository creates parent folders by design)

cases.title: The window opened on a corrupt database shows an error and stays alive
cases.expected: window visible; error/status text mentions the storage failure
cases.actual: alive=True message='تعذر فتح التخزين المحلي: file is not a database | تهيئة التخزين المحلي…'

cases.title: Settings do not touch stored data
cases.actual: GUI QA database missing

cases.title: Rule detection coverage by start time and duration (35 combinations, rules only, severity 1.0)
cases.expected: informational: every injected fault should either produce an event or be listed as a coverage gap
cases.notes: Gaps are documented limitations of the rule set under decelerating/idle/stopped conditions and short durations; not a recording defect.
